name: fastapicloud
description: Create, deploy, configure custom domains, connect services, inspect logs, and debug FastAPI apps on FastAPI Cloud.

interface.longDescription: Provides skills for creating and deploying FastAPI apps, configuring custom domains, connecting third-party resources, debugging failed deploys, inspecting app logs, and managing environment variables.
defaultPrompt: Create and deploy a FastAPI app to FastAPI Cloud.
Add and configure a custom domain for this FastAPI Cloud app.
Connect a managed service to this FastAPI Cloud app.
Inspect logs and diagnose this FastAPI Cloud deployment.
